title: 1 Northgrove Cres Whitby Open House Video Tour
description:
Situated on a premium corner lot, welcome to 1 Northgrove Crescent, a beautiful home in the north Whitby town of Brooklin.

This home features a single car garage, 2 car parking in the driveway, landscaped front garden, and a concrete covered porch wrapping around two sides of the home.

Warm and inviting, the interior living spaces of the main level showcase a ceramic tiled floor from the foyer, into the kitchen area; beautifully maintained hardwood floors and a gas fireplace in the combined living and dining areas; and California shutters on the windows.

The kitchen is open to all the living spaces, and features tiled back splashes; modern cabinetry with plenty of banter and storage space; and a L-shaped peninsula with double sink and breakfast seating. A walk-out from the breakfast area opens onto a fully fenced back yard.

The main level is complete with a 2-pc powder room and mirrored door double closet - and steps down from the foyer area provide access to an unspoiled basement ready to be transformed to suit family and personal needs.

A carpeted staircase leads to the upper level, which is carpeted throughout and features a linen closet, a 4-pc family washroom, and two bright and spacious secondary bedrooms - with one of these rooms having a walk-out to a balcony overlooking the street. The master bedroom comes with a walk-in closet, and a 4-pc ensuite.

This home is close to schools and parks, and is just minutes from neighbourhood shopping and restaurants, as well as access to Hwy 7.

For more information, contact Jeanette Barrett at (905) 706-2932, or Christina Arcangioli at (905) 723-5944, both of Keller Williams Energy Real Estate Brokerage.
author: Open House 24
